name: Data Analyst - MODA
description_html:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Mengidentifikasi sumber data yang relevan, mengumpulkan data yang dibutuhkan, serta melengkapi data yang hilang atau tidak lengkap dari sistem internal dan eksternal.
  • Melakukan pembersihan, validasi, dan persiapan data untuk memastikan akurasi, konsistensi, dan kemudahan penggunaan data.
  • Mengorganisir dan menyusun data mentah ke dalam format yang siap digunakan untuk analisis dan pelaporan.
  • Menganalisis dataset untuk menjawab pertanyaan bisnis tertentu dan menghasilkan insight yang dapat ditindaklanjuti.
  • Mengidentifikasi tren, pola, dan anomali dalam data untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
  • Mengembangkan visualisasi data, dashboard, dan laporan analitis menggunakan tools yang sesuai.
  • Menyiapkan dan mempresentasikan laporan analisis serta dashboard kepada manajemen eksekutif dan tim proyek.
  • Melakukan pelatihan dan sesi knowledge sharing, termasuk menyusun materi pelatihan serta mendukung tim lain dalam memahami struktur data dan konsep visualisasi.

Persyaratan

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Statistik, Matematika, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun sebagai Data Analyst atau posisi lain yang berfokus pada data.
  • Memiliki kemampuan organisasi, manajemen waktu, penentuan prioritas, dan multitasking yang baik dengan tingkat ketelitian yang tinggi.
  • Mahir menggunakan Power BI, termasuk data modeling, DAX, pembuatan dashboard, publikasi laporan, dan pengaturan refresh data.
  • Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut, termasuk Pivot Table, Power Query, formula lanjutan (INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP, array formulas), serta Macro.
  • Memiliki kemampuan SQL yang kuat (GoogleSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau sejenisnya) untuk query kompleks, ekstraksi, dan transformasi data.
  • Berpengalaman dalam proses integrasi data; memiliki pemahaman integrasi data SAP melalui SAP GUI menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik serta mampu menjelaskan hasil analisis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

name: Data Analyst
description_html:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our team. If you have excellent programming skills and a passion for developing applications or improving existing ones, we would like to meet you. As a Data Analyst, you’ll work closely with our engineers to ensure system consistency and improve user experience.

Data Analyst Roles And Responsibilities Include

  • Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports
  • Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality
  • Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems
  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets

Requirements

Skills

PT Metrodata Electronics, Tbk (Digital Solution Provider & Technology Innovator) would like to invite you to be part of the company to develop yourself and your skills. If you are:

  • Bachelor's Degree, Computer Science/Information Technology/Mathematics/Statistic

Metrodata not just offer for the job, we offer you for brighter career future.

name: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000302

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

Accommodation Data is the analytical engine behind how millions of travellers across Southeast Asia find and book the right place to stay — from budget guesthouses to premium international chains. We turn billions of search, pricing, and booking signals into the models and insights that shape supply quality, competitive pricing, ranking, and conversion. When a traveller sees the right property at the right price, that is our work.

Here you build at real scale on real markets, not slideware. You own problems end to end — framing the question, shipping the model or the analysis, and watching it move conversion and revenue across 11 countries. You will help build the cross-sell bridge that turns a flight booking into a full trip. We are not importing someone else's playbook for this region; we are writing our own, and you can write the next chapter of it.

About The Job

As a Senior Data Analyst on Traveloka’s Accommodation team, you are a senior expert individual contributor with no direct reports who develops and implements the operational analytics plan for the Accommodation business area — work with direct impact on that area’s overall results and performance.

  • Own and deliver the operational analytics plan for the Accommodation business area in line with the domain’s priorities, with your work directly shaping its results.
  • Tackle genuinely complex problems that require in-depth understanding of impact across operational, financial, and human-capital dimensions, and turn them into clear recommendations.
  • Build the advanced models, segmentations, and experiments the business uses to set direction, applying deep, well-developed expertise built from theory and experience.
  • Enhance the metric definitions, pipelines, and analytical processes your area runs on as part of project teams, raising the standard others inherit.
  • Persuade and convince senior business and tech stakeholders of the right course of action with evidence, even when the decision-making authority sits with them.
  • Set the technical bar for rigour and experimentation across a wide analytics surface, leading through expertise rather than line authority.
  • Propose strong inputs and mentor other analysts as the go-to expert, without owning a team or carrying people-management accountability.

Job Requirements

  • You have at least 5 years of relevant experience.
  • You are deeply expert in SQL, BI tooling, and advanced analytical methods — segmentation, experimentation, modelling — and still build hands-on.
  • You have repeatedly solved complex, ambiguous problems whose impact spans operations, finance, and people.
  • You design and interpret experiments to a high standard and improve how your area runs them.
  • You build dashboards, pipelines, and data products (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, cloud platforms) that the business trusts as the source of truth.
  • You influence senior business and tech leaders and have shaped real strategy with your analysis.
  • You are the technical reference point others come to — you raise the bar through expertise, not headcount.
  • You mentor and guide peers as a senior individual contributor, without managing a team.
  • You have a degree in a quantitative field (or equivalent) and typically at least 7 years in analytics, BI, or data science.
  • You communicate with executive presence in English — concise, clear, persuasive — and bring strong business acumen.
  • You have built a reusable analytics framework or self-serve data product that scaled across multiple teams.
  • You have led a high-stakes analytics initiative end to end and can point to the business decision it changed.
  • You have driven adoption of AI-assisted analytics among your peers while keeping rigour high.

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Data Analyst
description_html:
Role Description

The Data Analyst is responsible for translating data into actionable insights that support business decision-making and performance improvement. This role works closely with stakeholders to analyze business data, develop reports and dashboards, identify trends and opportunities, and provide data-driven recommendations that contribute to business growth and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support business decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for performance monitoring and business evaluation.
  • Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities through data analysis to support business growth and process improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation related to data analysis processes, methodologies, and findings.
  • Provide analytical support and recommendations to help achieve business objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or other related fields.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or similar analytical roles.
  • Proficient in SQL and at least one programming language for data analysis, such as Python or R.
  • Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts, statistical analysis, and data management practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business opportunities from data.
  • Ability to translate complex datasets into actionable insights and business recommendations.
  • Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with digital banking products and customer lifecycle concepts is a plus.

name: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and motivated Data Analyst to join our team in Bandung, Indonesia. In this role, you’ll support our data operations and reporting needs by working closely with teams across the business. You’ll help deliver accurate insights, improve data quality, and support data-driven decision-making.

Location – Hybrid, Indonesia (2 days per week in the office)


What You’ll be Doing

  • Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting frameworks that provide clear, actionable insights.
  • Collect data from multiple sources, maintain data quality, identify discrepancies, and help resolve data issues.
  • Build dashboards and reports based on defined business logic.
  • Validate data consistency across multiple reports.
  • Analyze reports and identify insights that help measure the company’s key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Work with stakeholders to define KPIs, interpret performance drivers, and recommend actions based on data.
  • Analyze trends and notify key users when KPI results appear incorrect or unusual.
  • Provide data and analysis to stakeholders as needed.
  • Work with the Data Engineering team to report missing or incorrect data and support improvements.
  • Maintain a list of activities and improvements, and support basic project coordination.
  • Communicate changes and new developments to business users.


About You

  • 5–7 years of experience in data analysis and reporting.
  • Mandatory: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Tableau.
  • Proven ability to analyze large volumes of data, identify actionable insights, and communicate findings to stakeholders—not just build dashboards and reports.
  • Experience integrating data across BI platforms, data warehouses, and operational tools, such as Sales Operations systems, while ensuring data consistency and integrity
  • A strong business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect data to commercial context and focus on outcomes.
  • Experience working with stakeholders.
  • Good English communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • A collaborative, dependable, trustworthy, customer-focused, and solution-oriented approach.

A big plus if you have

  • Experience with Databricks, particularly developing SQL dashboards.
  • Familiarity with data warehouse concepts, including Medallion Architecture and Star Schema.
  • Experience supporting commercial or operational reporting in SaaS or subscription-based businesses.


About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.


The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.


NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.


What You’ll Love

  • We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community
  • We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week
  • We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement
  • Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally
  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
  • Receive competitive compensation
  • Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

  • Additional Information

    Applicants must hold valid working rights in Indonesia at the time of application. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.


    We are an equal opportunity employer in accordance with Indonesia's Manpower Law. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees.
